patch_description: Replace the slow numerical-gradient L-BFGS-B and ineffective Nelder-Mead stages with (a) a fast annealed analytic-gradient ascent on a soft-minimum of the pairwise distances (with points kept centered and scaled so dmax=1 after every step, which handles scale invariance exactly), and (b) the exact SLSQP polish (maximize t subject to t^2 <= ||pi-pj||^2 <= 1) from the 1.00-scoring program, plus jitter restarts of the polish. This is ~20x faster per optimization run than L-BFGS-B with numerical gradients, freeing budget for many more structured/random starts, while the SLSQP stage polishes to the best known configuration.
